summary: Answer strict exact RFI/Submittal drawing-reference questions from explicitly prefixed same-workflow primary evidence before model dispatch.
decision_refs: The active objective requires efficient accurate questions across RFI, Submittal and Email content
The shared answer validator already defines an atomic explicit Sheet, Drawing, Dwg and Detail identifier boundary
The existing workflow index and immutable evidence can answer exact reference lists without a second index or provider cost
approval_evidence: The persistent objective authorizes bounded efficiency, accuracy and adaptability improvements across RFI, Submittal and Email question flows.
known_limitations: Only strict English questions naming one exact RFI or Submittal and an explicit reference category use the local shortcut.
Only digit-bearing values with a Sheet, Drawing, Dwg or Detail prefix in exact primary evidence participate; unlabelled codes do not.
More than eight distinct references, wrong or multiple workflow scope, quoted history, vision narration and more than 32 primary files or candidate passages fail closed.
The shortcut does not infer applicability, discipline, revision, chronology, authority or which drawing controls.
